mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_feedback ( tenant_id, user_id, conversation_id, message_id, rating, comment, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{rating}, #{comment}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rating = VALUES(rating), comment = VALUES(comment), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, conversation_id, message_id, rating, comment, created_at, updated_at FROM message_feedback WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND message_id = #{messageId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 'HELPFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS helpful_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 'NOT_HELPFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS not_helpful_count FROM message_feedback WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
